archive.name: Shopobot
archive.about: tracks the surprisingly frequent price changes at popular stores, and helps people decide the best time and place to buy.

archive.name: SideCar
archive.about: SideCar is a community-based, real-time ridesharing marketplace.

sentences: === Investments === Sidecar was backed by a number of wealthy investors including Union Square Ventures, Avalon Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Google Ventures, and Sir Richard Branson.
The company raised in series A funding from Google Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners in 2012.

archive.name: Stickery
archive.about: is a mobile learning game platform for preschool kids, with post-game analytics for parents. The company's vision is to empower parents to be better teachers.

archive.name: Stitch
archive.about: Stitch is a mobile email app that allows salespeople to be as effective and responsive on the go as when sitting in front of a desk.

archive.name: Super.cc
archive.about: Super.cc is a smart and simple tool for adding events to your calendar.

archive.name: Superplastic
archive.about: Superplsatic is a character-based product and animated entertainment company.

archive.name: SynapDx
archive.about: SynapDx is developing a blood test to enable earlier diagnosis of Autism Spectrum Disorders.

archive.name: The Orange Chef Co.
archive.about: The Orange Chef is creating a smarter kitchen through connected devices, including a smart food scale that visualizes nutrition.

archive.name: The Wing
archive.about: The Wing is a growing community of women across the country and globe, gathering together to work, connect, and thrive.

archive.name: TinyRx
archive.about: TinyRx improves access to healthcare with same day, on demand prescription delivery.

archive.name: Triptrotting
archive.about: Triptrotting is a community connecting travelers with like-minded locals for meetups and authentic experiences.

archive.name: Wantworthy
archive.about: Wantworthy lets users save products from any site into one list and makes it easy for them to organize their finds, get feedback from people they care about, and decide what to buy later.

archive.name: Wearable Intelligence
archive.about: Wearable Intelligence is helping service workers go hands-free by providing enterprise solutions for wearable technology, including Google Glass.

archive.name: Weotta
archive.about: Weotta helps you discover, build, and share your infinite wish list of things to do and places to go.

archive.name: Wittlebee
archive.about: Wittlebee is a kids clothing club that aims to keep parents well stocked with the basics like onesies, t-shirts, socks, leggings, and more.

archive.name: WUT
archive.about: WUT is a mobile app for sharing ephemeral messages with friends anonymously.

archive.name: Zeus Living
archive.about: Zeus leases unfurnished, privately-owned homes and convert them into expertly appointed, convenient, and full-service corporate housing units for today’s global professional.
